name: sync coverage live-oracle import isolation
$limitation: Pins the production coverage builder's dependency boundary so the Go-quality live oracle cannot silently regain planner and Celery runtime imports. It does not attempt to restate every dependency in the locked CI environment; that closure is separately derived from uv.lock.

mutations.rationale: Importing the production coverage payload builder for the Python-to-Go oracle must not initialize the planner, provider clients, or Celery worker runtime.
